recipes.name: Sagano Smoke
observations: Menu lists Hibiki Harmony, Ardbeg Wee Beastie, matcha, honey, lemon, and whole egg.
Menu price: $24 at time of visit.
Photograph shows an opaque green cocktail served up in a stemmed glass with a thick pale-green foam cap and fine green powder dusting.
No ice visible in the serving glass.

ingredients.name: Honey syrup (2 parts honey : 1 part water by weight)

steps: Make 2:1 honey syrup by mixing two parts honey with one part warm water by weight; chill.
Sift matcha into a shaker and whisk with fresh lemon juice until smooth.
Add both whiskies, honey syrup, and a small pasteurized whole egg.
Dry shake without ice vigorously for 15–20 seconds.
Add ice and shake hard for 12–15 seconds.
Double-strain into a chilled stemmed cocktail glass.
Let foam settle for 20–30 seconds and dust lightly with sifted matcha.
alternatives: If smoke is overpowering, use 1½ oz / 45 mL Hibiki and ½ oz / 15 mL Ardbeg.
recipe.foodSafety: Use pasteurized egg; serve immediately; raw unpasteurized eggs carry Salmonella risk.

unresolvedQuestions: Test v1.0 at home and compare peat intensity, sweetness, acidity, and foam density to original.

Confirm original preparation technique and ingredient proportions if bartender details become available.
recipes.notes: Version 1.0 experimental reconstruction based on strong smoke, balanced sweet-acid, rich texture, and no additional smoke presentation. Menu identifies ingredients but not proportions; all measured amounts are experimental, not the bar's verified formula.
